Text.Text: Work order complete. My crews can return to the yard, and your hazard pay is settled. You've finished my Adamantine Guard trials. I have no further work for you here.
This work needs rank 50 in Katar. Train those hands first, then come back for the yard contract.

A wreck crew is running unauthorized katar drills on my tonnage and my clock. Their work order will tell me who signed them in. Defeat six Adamantine Guard Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs. I'll give you the CZ-220 Breaker Yard Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Adamantine Guard.

Here's the CZ-220 Breaker Yard Key. Use 'Enter the Breaker Bay' in CZ-220, Maintenance Level. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Adamantine Guard Adepts, then return with the Adamantine Guard Breaker Yard Work Order.

Everything the galaxy is done with. Freighters, barge hulls, one decommissioned corvette I wasn't supposed to ask about. We cut it, sort it, weigh it, sell it. Then last quarter a katar crew walked in with a guard drill and a stack of forged dockets, and the first thing they broke was my schedule. The one thing down there that never broke is why they came. Ask me about that when you've earned the deeper bays.

Wreckers I'd have hired, which is the insulting part. They drill a guard that doesn't give - adamantine, they call it - fists up, feet planted, hours at a stretch, on my power draw. Their foreman files my forms in my own format. Accurate paperwork from thieves. I almost respect it. Almost.

It means whoever holds it holds the bay. That's yard law older than this station's registry. Their copy carries a forged authorization with my stamp on it, and while that flimsi exists, half my subcontractors think the lockout is mine. Bring it back and I start reclaiming my yard one bay at a time.
Defeat six Adamantine Guard Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs.
You've defeated six Adamantine Guard Adepts. Let me see the Adamantine Guard Breaker Yard Work Order.
Work order received. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have taken over the junkline controls. I need that relay back before they wreck another shift's work. Defeat five Adamantine Guard Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs.
Your key still grants access to CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Defeat five Adamantine Guard Specialists to secure the Adamantine Guard Junkline Control Relay, then return to me.

A guard that doesn't break, drilled until it's true. You'd know what that's worth to a katar hand better than I would - I just know what it looks like from a crane cab. My cutters held a plasma lance on one of those adepts for a full minute and he didn't step back. Whatever they're perfecting down there, they didn't invent it. They're drilling it to sell it, and my yard is the free training floor.

That relay is the junkline's spine. Whoever holds it decides where every belt in this yard delivers, and right now that's five squatters with katars and a work ethic I'd kill for. It's also serial-stamped to my yard. Get it back and their reroute becomes theft on paper, which is the only place theft ever really dies.

They work together: one holds the bay while the others move the equipment. My riggers were trying to handle each problem alone. Bring help if you can; teamwork is the part of their method worth copying.
Defeat five Adamantine Guard Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs.
You've defeated five Adamantine Guard Specialists. Let me see the Adamantine Guard Junkline Control Relay.
Component received and accounted for. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

Their warden is holding the Breaker Bay. Recover her sigil so I can establish who authorized the damage. Defeat the Adamantine Guard Warden in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Sheared Bay Sigil; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In CZ-220, Breaker Bay, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Adamantine Guard Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Adamantine Guard Sheared Bay Sigil.

I recommend two companions against the Adamantine Guard Warden. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

The cable snap took that bay off my books before I made foreman. It also left the one thing this yard never managed to break - a bulkhead section that ate the whole whipping cable and didn't dent. That's what drew this crew here. You don't drill an unbreakable guard just anywhere. You drill it in front of the thing that taught it.

Every bay in this yard carries a sigil plate. Cast when the bay is commissioned, pulled when it dies. The sheared bay's plate should have been pulled twenty years ago; their warden wears it like a badge instead. It's my property and my bay's death certificate, and I want it filed properly. Sentiment and paperwork are the same thing if you do them right.

Defeat the Adamantine Guard Warden in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Sheared Bay Sigil; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Adamantine Guard Warden. Let me see the Adamantine Guard Sheared Bay Sigil.
The warden's defeat is verified. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four foremen still have the authority to keep this operation running. Recover their override chip. Defeat four members of the Adamantine Guard Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs.
Your key still grants access to CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Defeat four members of the Adamantine Guard Inner Circle to secure the Adamantine Guard Foreman's Override Chip, then return to me.

The foreman's original crew. The four who walked in with him the first day, back when I still thought they were a salvage bid. Each one has been drilled to hold a bay alone against a full cutting team. They rotate my crane deck in pairs, they sleep in shifts, and they have never once broken my safety regs. Model workers. I want their names off my roster by the weekend.

Used right, nothing - it's a foreman's tool, it makes the yard obey. Used wrong, my stacked hulls come down through the maintenance level and CZ-220 stops having a lower deck. They haven't used it. That's what worries me. People who steal a scalpel and don't cut are waiting for a patient. Get it back before they pick one.

He holds Bay One. The first bay this yard ever commissioned, the one I apprenticed in, and he's turned it into his private drill floor. The crew, the reroute, the chip - all of it is a fence around that one room. He knows I want it back, and he guards it with the only thing in this yard that never breaks. Himself. That bill comes due after the chip.
Defeat four members of the Adamantine Guard Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Adamantine Guard Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs.
You've defeated four members of the Adamantine Guard Inner Circle. Let me see the Adamantine Guard Foreman's Override Chip.
Authorization recovered. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is keeping the yard under his own guard. Remove him and I can close this work order. Defeat the Adamantine Guard Master in CZ-220, Breaker Yard. Report back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In CZ-220, Breaker Yard, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Adamantine Guard Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

He's the best guard in that crew. My crane operator saw him stop a wrecking ball on crossed blades. I don't know how much of that story to believe, but I know he hasn't given the yard back. Defeating him is the last part of your contract.

My name is on the commissioning plate. Third apprentice, bottom line, T. Kade. Everyone else on that plate is dead or shipped out, and that room is where I learned that doing the work right is the only kindness that holds. He has been sleeping under my plate for two quarters. I want it back on my grid, cutting hulls, doing honest tonnage. That's all. That's everything.

Then I write the last page. Crew cleared, bays reclaimed, override seated, Bay One recommissioned. A clean file, front to back, and a standing line on my roster with your name on it - rated for anything, paid on time, no questions. Around here that isn't a favor. It's the highest thing I sign.

Defeat the Adamantine Guard Master in CZ-220, Breaker Yard. Report back to me here in CZ-220, Offices & Labs; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Adamantine Guard Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
Work order complete. My crews can return to the yard, and your hazard pay is settled. You've earned the right to train Adamantine Guard. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the work order.
I'll defeat six Adamantine Guard Adepts.
What does this yard actually break?
Whose crew is squatting in your yard?
Why does one flimsi matter that much?
Not this shift.
Here's the Adamantine Guard Breaker Yard Work Order.
About the relay job.
I'll defeat five Adamantine Guard Specialists.
What are they actually training down there?
What's one relay worth to you?
How did five people take an entire junkline?
The belts can wait one more shift.
Here's the Adamantine Guard Junkline Control Relay.
Back to the sheared bay.
I'll defeat the Adamantine Guard Warden.
What makes this warden different?
What happened in the sheared bay?
What's the sigil to you?
Then I'll come back with a crew.
Here's the Adamantine Guard Sheared Bay Sigil.
About the chip.
I'll defeat four members of the Adamantine Guard Inner Circle.
Who are the four?
What happens if they use it?
And their foreman - the one running all this?
Four at once takes planning. Hold the order.
Here's the Adamantine Guard Foreman's Override Chip.
Back to Bay One.
I'll face the Adamantine Guard Master and report back.
A week without moving. What is he?
What's in Bay One that's worth all this to you?
And after he's down? What then?
Not until my crew is ready. He'll keep.
The Adamantine Guard Master is defeated. Here's my report.
